summary: Iteration 6 — Tested MQTT broker connection fixes end-to-end. Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/broker/test validated for 6 scenarios (good host:1883/tls=off, wrong 8883+TLS, wrong 8883 no-TLS, invalid DNS host with timeout bound, empty host, viewer forbidden). Also validated GET /api/admin/settings exposes broker_connected + broker_last_error, and verified real broker reconnection cycle: switching simulation_enabled=false with host=156.67.82.199:1883/TLS=off results in broker_connected=true within ~6s; switching to 8883/TLS=true produces broker_connected=false with Portuguese error message; simulation restored to true after each test. Frontend Admin → Broker tab verified: all data-testids present (test-broker-button, broker-status, broker-host, broker-port, broker-tls-toggle, broker-username, broker-password, broker-prefix, broker-client-id, simulation-mode-switch, save-settings-button). TLS toggle auto-adjusts port (1883↔8883) in both directions. Click on 'test-broker-button' with 156.67.82.199:1883 TLS off shows toast 'Conexão com broker OK'.
critical_code_review_comments: mqtt_service._start_real: synchronous connect() is correct for immediate socket error capture; however, no explicit socket timeout is set on the client before connect — a hostile host that accepts TCP but never replies with CONNACK could hang the sync connect. Current paho default blocks on name resolution + TCP SYN. Consider using client.connect_async + loop_start with manual timeout in start_real if ever an issue (not reproduced here).

test_connection catches ConnectionRefusedError/OSError before loop_start, but when loop_start is in flight with wrong-TLS-port, CONNACK never arrives — returns 'Timeout aguardando resposta do broker' after 6s. Message is correct but could be more specific (e.g., 'possível incompatibilidade TLS'). Minor UX improvement.
The frontend toast for failed broker test showed in logs intermittently; Sonner default 4s might not be enough visibility for long error strings. Consider increasing duration for error toasts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 6 broker-related features verified. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_broker.py (9 tests, all pass in ~5s). Simulation left ON after teardown; no residual broker config change. Do NOT re-run full suite unless broker/mqtt files change.
rca of the issue: User reported 'NÃO ESTÁ CONECTANDO COM O SERVIDOR BROKER' because UI defaulted to port 8883+TLS, while the real broker at 156.67.82.199 is on 1883 without TLS. Fix in iteration 6 changed BrokerConfig defaults to port=1883 tls=False, added synchronous connect to capture real socket errors, added last_error exposure, added test-connection endpoint. All validated as working. Reproduction confirmed in backend test test_real_broker_bad_port_shows_error (8883/TLS=true → 'Conexão recusada'/'Timeout' error reported in broker_last_error). Mitigation: user should toggle TLS off in Admin UI (which auto-sets port to 1883) and save; backend reconnects and reports broker_connected=true.
